summary:
Complete 4-slide interactive web presentation for Blockbuster Digital CIS, built to follow the exact Technical Pitch PDF template structure.

**Slide 1 (1.1.1 Company Profile)**: Student names, software name, target company, core activity card, services offered, and "Stakeholder Needs Analysis" vocabulary tag. Presenter: Maria Fernanda Huertas Montes.

**Slide 2 (1.1.2 Problem Statement & Requirements Refinement)**: Business issues alert card with exact template text, plus 3 stacked requirements cards with grammar callouts ('lacks', 'requires') and vocabulary tags ('Epic', 'User Story', 'Bottleneck', 'Workflow', 'CIS', 'Functional Requirement', 'Non-Functional Requirement'). Presenter: Juan Camilo Valencia Rey.

**Slide 3 (1.1.3 Proposed Solution & CIS Workflow)**: Asymmetric two-column layout. Left: software introduction, CIS architecture description, 3-point key features checklist, and "best option" rationale. Right: Full SVG flowchart replicating the VIP Rental Payment Flow with exact node shapes and colors (light blue ovals, peach diamonds, rose pink rectangles, mint green rectangles, gray exception handlers), hover tooltips, and zoom controls. Presenter: Jhoan Steven Murillo Garcia.

**Slide 4 (1.1.4 Expected Results & Impact)**: Three horizontal impact cards (Speeds Up, Improves, Secures) with exact template sentences, closing banner with thank-you, and full development team footer. Presenter: Valeria Becerra Giraldo.

Design: Dark navy #0A0E1A background, #FFD100 yellow accents, CRT scanline overlay, smooth slide transitions, keyboard navigation (arrows/space), dot indicators, presenter badges.
